blog_title: Rakhi Bulk T-Shirt Order Deadline 2025 — When to Order Plain Tshirts to Avoid Courier Delay
caption:
Ordered 500 tees on Aug 20 for Rakhi. Courier sat in transit. Zero delivery. 😬

Here's what we learned after 9 years: festival week courier delays are real. Train despatch hits the road faster — subah nikal jaate hain. Despatch day matters more than order day.

210 GSM @ ₹140/pc. Order NOW if you want Aug 28 delivery, not Aug 25.

Save this if you're prepping bulk orders for Raksha Bandhan 👇
